caveat: Five processed scenes retain LLFF poses and downsampled PLY but have deleted original COLMAP/dense intermediates. Structural checks and color-projection diagnostics do not certify full SfM/MVS accuracy.

flame_calibration_crosscheck.note: Known original COLMAP model confirms pose row ordering and LLFF axis recovery. poses_bounds keeps fx only; fx and fy are not identical in the original PINHOLE model.

known_firstframe_only_input.reason: Only frame0000 contains real images; later directories are metadata placeholders, as stated in its README.

warnings: coffee_martini and flame_salmon_1 have a substantial extreme-distance tail in the 40000-point FPS seed cloud; inspect multi-view support/depth before constructing cleaned variants. Distance alone is not an automatic delete rule.

Only flame_steak preserves the original undistorted COLMAP model and complete full-size undistorted frames. Five scenes retain processed half-resolution LLFF inputs, not the exact original per-camera PINHOLE intrinsics or MVS intermediates.
Current 1600x1199 flame_steak results use a different resolution from the approximately 1345-wide S2GS training data; align the full-dataset protocol before combining results.
Five scenes still need matching native first-frame Gaussian checkpoints and loader adapters before dynamic my4dgs training.
